subject: general
question: Black soil is predominantly found in which one of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Black soil, also known as **Regur soil,** is rich in clay and has a **high moisture-retaining capacity**, making it suitable for certain types of agriculture.
 
• This type of soil is predominantly found in the **Deccan Plateau region of India**, particularly in states like **Maharashtra, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, and parts of Karnataka.**
 
• Black soil is particularly** favorable for growing cotton**, which is why it is often referred to as** "cotton soil." **It also supports the cultivation of crops like sorghum (jowar), millet, and various pulses.
 
• Black soil is formed from volcanic rocks and is rich in minerals like **iron, calcium, and magnesium,** contributing to its fertility.
 
• The regions with black soil generally experience a** semi-arid climate**, which influences the types of crops that can be cultivated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka:**

 
 
• While **black soil **is found in parts of Karnataka, it is not as predominant as in Maharashtra, where it covers a larger area.
 
 
 
• **Jharkhand:**
 
 
• The state has a** mix of soil types**, including red and alluvial soils, but black soil is not a major feature.
 
 
 
• **Odisha:**
 
 
• Odisha primarily has **laterite and alluvial soils,** with black soil being less common.
 
 
 
• **Soil Management:**
 
 
• Farmers in black soil regions often employ specific **agricultural practices to maximize crop yields**, including the use of organic matter and crop rotation.
 
 
 
• **Economic Importance:**
 
 
• The cotton grown in black soil regions plays a significant role in the** textile industry, **contributing to the economy of states like Maharashtra.
